reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, linking a passivating oxide and a refined subsurface to synergistic wear-corrosion resistance, though the claim that a single thermal treatment can simultaneously produce both a self-healing oxide and an ultra-nanocrystalline subsurface in a bulk HEA is mechanistically ambitious and not fully justified.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and well-defined, with specific measurements and a decisive falsification criterion, but it lacks details on how the thermal treatment will be controlled to independently verify the formation of both the oxide and the refined subsurface layer.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses a key challenge in tribocorrosion of HEAs with a testable, dual-structure mechanism, making it a valuable direction for experimental investigation despite some uncertainty about the practicality of the proposed treatment.
